source_issue.title: The listing of the substitutions variables in the send e-mail action is missing in volto.

summary_markdown:
```markdown
## What this issue is about
This issue addresses the lack of visibility for substitution variables in the "send e-mail" action of Volto's Control Panel for the `plone.app.contentrules` package. These variables are currently functional but not displayed in the UI or the Plone 6 documentation, making it difficult for users to understand their options.

## What needs to be done
We need to create a way to display the list of available substitution variables directly in the Volto Control Panel UI. This may involve adapting an existing TAL-based solution (which previously listed substitutions in Plone 4) to the React-based Volto environment.

## Helpful background
Substitution variables allow dynamic content to be included in emails, enhancing user experience. The official Plone 6 documentation lacks a section on Content Rules, and earlier docs from Plone 5 also missed this critical functionality. 

## Good first steps
1. Review existing TAL templates used in Plone 4 for inspiration.
2. Check the default substitution variable code in [plone.stringinterp](https://github.com/plone/plone.stringinterp).
3. Consider creating a simple mockup of how the substitutions can be displayed in the UI.
4. If you find outdated or ambiguous discussions, feel free to raise those points for clarification.

Your contributions will help improve the documentation and user experience for Plone!
```
